source_report.rationale: PR #61 exact-head matrix evidence showed b7-p8-c256k-warm64 was internally repeatable but changed the frozen rook-endgame bestmove from f2f3 to h2h3 in all three repeats. In the same bound matrix, b4-p0-c256k-cold matched the frozen 8/8 baseline vector in its discovery observation while also reducing wall time. This commit proposes b4-p0-c256k-cold; promotion still requires the existing three-repeat exact-head aggregate qualification and the unchanged G3 non-anchor witness gate.

claim_boundary: Proposed from retained PR #61 exact-head ENGINE-OPT evidence and subject to fresh three-repeat exact-head qualification on the candidate head. This is not an Elo, superiority, equal-compute, generic-portability, GPU, or deployment claim.
